place_fields.summary: Sightseeing tour operator in Chikkamagaluru offering guided jeep trekking and multi-day routes covering mountain viewpoints, waterfalls, coffee areas, temples and forest attractions.

planning_attributes.description: Jeep trekking and tourist guide service based on Mallandur Road in Chikkamagaluru, offering guided sightseeing and jeep-based excursions across the surrounding hill and nature attractions.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located at Chikamagalu Cars on Mallandur Road, Chikkamagaluru, Karnataka 577101.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Some destinations on the advertised itineraries are subject to forest or site-specific access rules; availability and access can vary by destination.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Mountain and forest excursions can involve rough jeep tracks, steep hill roads and slippery conditions during rain; follow the guide's instructions and applicable forest/site rules.
planning_attributes.notes: The operator advertises jeep-based sightseeing itineraries including Mullayanagiri, Baba Budangiri, Jhari Falls, Kemmangundi, Bhadra Tiger Reserve and other Chikkamagaluru-area attractions.
